values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

note: Rustic campground on the sandy shore of Pickerel Lake in the Pigeon River Country State Forest, ~10 mi NE of Vanderbilt via Sturgeon Valley Rd and Pickerel Lake Rd; the largest and most popular PRC family campground. Trash collection. Small shallow gravel boat launch adjacent (electric motors only); Pickerel Lake Pathway access. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: $20, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 39 sites (all confirmed, derived -> manual); 15-day max (inherited, now stated). Sites 'suitable for tent and small trailer use' (boilerplate, silent on length). Season 'open all year' already manual, left. Amenity table types it 'rustic', not equestrian; ORV operation between campground and trails 'no'. Access via Sturgeon Valley Rd and Pickerel Lake Rd, no road warning on the page. Note trimmed of field restatements.
